'''Vyacheslav Rychkov''' (called '''Slava Rychkov''', Russian Вячеслав Рычков, transcription Vyacheslav Rychkov; born 27 May 1975 in Samara, Russia <ref name="CV">{{Cite web|url=https://docs.google.com/viewer?a=v&pid=sites&srcid=ZGVmYXVsdGRvbWFpbnxzbGF2YXJ5Y2hrb3Z8Z3g6M2YyN2RhOGIxMTQ1YmI2OA|title=CVlong-Rychkov-2020.pdf|website=docs.google.com}}</ref>) is a Russian-Italian-French<ref name="CV"/> theoretical physicist and mathematician. 

== Career ==
In 1996, Rychkov obtained his diploma ([[Bachelor of Science|B.S.]], [[Master of Science|M.S.]]) from the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]].<ref name="CV"/> From 1996 to 1998 he studied at the [[University of Jena]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cms.rz.uni-jena.de/matia2/Mitglieder/Ehemalige.html|title=Ehemalige Mitglieder (seit 1995)|website=cms.rz.uni-jena.de}}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> He received his doctorate in mathematics from [[Princeton University Department of Mathematics|Princeton University]], under the supervision of [[Elias M. Stein|Elias Stein]], in 2002<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=58619|title=Vyacheslav Rychkov - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> with a thesis titled "Estimates for Oscillatory Integral Operators".<ref>{{Cite arXiv|title = Vyacheslav Rychkov, "Estimates for Oscillatory Integral Operators", Princeton University PhD Thesis, math/0204269|eprint = math/0204269|last1 = Rychkov|first1 = Vyacheslav S.|year = 2002}}</ref> [[Alexander Markovich Polyakov|Alexander Polyakov]] was his unofficial supervisor.<ref name="hepnames" /> He was a post-doctoral fellow at the [[University of Amsterdam]] (2002-2005) and at the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa|Scuola Normale Superiore]] in Pisa, where he became assistant professor in 2007.<ref name="hepnames">{{Cite web|url=http://inspirehep.net/record/990861?ln=en|title=Record #990861 - INSPIRE-HEP}}</ref> In 2009 he became a professor of physics at the [[University of Paris VI]] and a member of the Laboratory of Theoretical Physics at the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris.<ref name="CV"/> Since 2012 to 2017 he was a staff member of the Department of Theoretical Physics at [[CERN]].<ref name = "hepnames"/> He has been a [[Mitsubishi Heavy Industries]] Professor of High Energy Physics at École Normale Supérieure in Paris since 2016 <ref>{{Cite web|url = https://www.ens.fr/espace-presse/inauguration-des-chaires-ens-mhi-25-octobre-2016|title = Inauguration des Chaires ENS –MHI - 25 octobre 2016}}</ref> and in 2017 he became a permanent professor at the [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ihes.fr/en/slava-rychkov-joins-the-institute-as-a-permanent-professor/|title = Slava Rychkov joins the Institute as a permanent professor|date = 12 December 2017}}</ref>

== Research ==
Slava Rychkov’s research interests mostly concern problems of theoretical physics to which the methods of [[quantum field theory]] and [[conformal field theory]] are applicable. He is the deputy director of the international collaboration on the nonperturbative bootstrap<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bootstrapcollaboration.com/members/|title = List of members of the Simons collaboration on Nonperturbative Bootstrap}}</ref> financed by the [[Simons Foundation]]. 

== Awards ==
Between 2012 and 2017 he was a Junior Member of l’[[Institut Universitaire de France]].<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/1409-vyacheslav-rychkov.html|title = Vyacheslav Rychkov's membership in Institut Universitaire de France}}</ref>

In 2014 he received the [[New Horizons in Physics Prize]] “For developing new techniques in conformal field theory, reviving the conformal bootstrap program for constraining the spectrum of operators and the structure constants in 3D and 4D CFT’s.”<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://breakthroughprize.org/Laureates/1/L23|title=Breakthrough Prize – Fundamental Physics Breakthrough Prize Laureates – Vyacheslav Rychkov|website=breakthroughprize.org|access-date=2019-08-05}}</ref>

He was the 2019 laureate of the Grand Prix Mergier-Bourdeix of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] for his work on the [[conformal bootstrap]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Laureats/prix-mergier-bourdeix-2019-slava-rychkov.html|title = Lauréat 2019 du prix Mergier-Bourdeix : Slava Rychkov}}</ref>
